examples.english: I saw a musical at the theater.

notes:
{劇場|げきじょう} means theater or playhouse - a venue for live performances such as plays, musicals, and operas.

COMPONENTS:
- {劇|げき}: drama, play
- {場|じょう}: place, venue

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {劇場|げきじょう}で{見|み}る: to see at the theater
- {劇場|げきじょう}{公開|こうかい}: theatrical release
- {劇場|げきじょう}{版|ばん}: theatrical version
- {国立|こくりつ}{劇場|げきじょう}: national theater

CONTRAST:
- {劇場|げきじょう}: theater (for live performances)
- {映画|えいが}{館|かん}: movie theater
- ホール: hall (concert hall)

JAPANESE THEATERS:
- 歌舞伎座: Kabuki-za (Tokyo, kabuki theater)
- 宝塚{大劇場|だいげきじょう}: Takarazuka Grand Theater
- {国立|こくりつ}{劇場|げきじょう}: National Theatre of Japan
